scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Sorry but you can't get married right now.
The wedding is only available for subscribed players.
But if you have a ^FF0000Marriage Covenant^000000, then you'll be able to get married!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
抱歉，您现在无法结婚。
婚礼服务仅对订阅玩家开放。
但如果您拥有^FF0000结婚契约^000000，就可以结婚了！

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Hello~
My name is Marry Happy
and I'm here to provide you
with information related to
marriage. Now, did you
have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
你好~
我是玛丽·哈皮，
负责为您提供
与婚姻相关的资讯。
请问您有什么
想要咨询的吗？

scripts.text: I want to get married.
scripts.translation: 我想结婚。

scripts.text: I don't need your help!
scripts.translation: 我不需要你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Oh, I'm sorry, but
adopted characters
aren't allowed to get
married. For now, why
don't you enjoy the simple
pleasures of childhood?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
哎呀，很抱歉，
被收养的角色
是不允许结婚的。
既然这样，
不如先享受一下
童年的乐趣吧？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Oh, of course you
don't! Little children
can't get married-- there
are too many laws against
that~ Aren't you the most
adorable little thing?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
哦，当然不行啦！
小孩子是不能结婚的——
相关的法律太多了~
你真是最可爱的
小宝贝呢？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Marriage is the beautiful
union of two souls that have
chosen to be together forever,
to share their joy and lives.
Is there a special someone
like that in your life?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
婚姻是两个灵魂
选择永远在一起，
分享快乐与生活的
美丽结合。
在你的生命中，
有这样特别的人吗？

scripts.text: Ask about Wedding Ceremony
scripts.translation: 询问婚礼仪式

scripts.text: Ask about Procedure
scripts.translation: 询问流程

scripts.text: Apply for Wedding
scripts.translation: 申请结婚

scripts.text: We are the Invincible Single Army!
scripts.translation: 我们是无敌的单身军团！

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Wise and benevolent
King Tristram III used to
conduct wedding ceremonies,
but he's no longer able to do
so because of his royal duties
and freneticly paced schedule.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
睿智仁慈的
国王特里斯坦三世
过去曾主持婚礼仪式，
但由于王室事务繁忙
且日程紧凑，
他已无法继续担任此职。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Bishop Vomars, the bishop
of love, is now the officiator
of the marriage ceremony.
He is truly a treasure to the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
现在，由爱之主教
沃马斯担任
婚礼仪式的主持人。
他真是卢恩·米德加兹
王国的瑰宝。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
When you marry someone,
it's for the rest of your life, so think carefully before making or
accepting a marriage proposal.
Keep in mind that a man can only
marry a woman and vice versa.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
结婚是一辈子的事，
所以在提出或接受
求婚之前，
请仔细考虑。
请记住，男性只能
与女性结婚，反之亦然。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
If you're lucky enough to
find someone that you really
want to spend the rest of your
life with, you might want to pop the question. I hope everyone
finds their perfect match~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
如果你幸运地找到了
那个你想共度余生的人，
不妨大胆求婚吧。
希望每个人都能
找到完美的伴侣~

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
The first part of the
wedding procedure is to
complete the application.
Once the bride and bridegroom
have finished applying, they
must form a party of two.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
婚礼流程的第一步
是完成申请。
当新郎和新娘
都完成申请后，
必须组成一个两人的队伍。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
After forming a party of two,
the couple must then speak to
Bishop Vomars. The bridegroom
speaks first and must tell his
bride's exact name to the Bishop. Otherwise, the ceremony will stop.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
组成两人队伍后，
情侣必须与
主教沃马斯对话。
新郎先说话，
必须向主教说出
新娘的准确名字。
否则，仪式将会中断。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Afterwards, the bride will
speak to the Bishop and tell
him the name of her groom.
If these names are correctly
told to the Bishop, they will
be able to exchange rings.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
之后，新娘会与
主教对话，并说出
新郎的名字。
如果向主教报出的
名字正确，
他们就可以交换戒指了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Once the wedding rings are
exchanged, the couple is forever bound in matrimony. Of course,
before this point, there are many chances to change your mind, so...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
一旦交换了结婚戒指，
情侣便永远结为夫妻。
当然，在此之前，
还有很多机会可以
改变主意，所以...

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
If there are too many
couples who want to get
married at one time, please
form a line and speak to Bishop
Vomars in order since only one couple can be married at a time.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
如果同时想要结婚的
情侣太多，请排好队，
按顺序与主教沃马斯对话，
因为一次只能
为一对情侣举行婚礼。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Finally, be sure to tell
Bishop Vomars your partner's
exact name without wasting too much time. If you take too long,
the ceremony will automatically stop and you'll have to try again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
最后，请务必在不过多耽误时间的情况下，向主教沃马斯准确说出您伴侣的名字。如果耗时过长，仪式将自动中断，届时您需要重新尝试。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Brides need to remember
that they only have 3 minutes
to finish speaking to Bishop
Vomars after their grooms
have finished speaking to him.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
新娘们请记住，在新郎与主教沃马斯对话结束后，您只有3分钟的时间完成与主教的对话。

scripts.text: Thanks, that helps a lot!
scripts.translation: 谢谢，这很有帮助！

scripts.text: Easiest way to say my partner's name?
scripts.translation: 最简单说出伴侣名字的方法是什么？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Well, I'm here to help
weddings proceed as
smoothly as possible.
If there was something
you didn't understand,
feel free to ask me again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
我的职责是确保婚礼尽可能顺利地进行。
如果您有任何不明白的地方，请随时再次向我询问。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
The easiest way to write
your partner's name for the
bishop is to send a private
message to your partner, and
then left-click the name section that is left of the chat prompt.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
向主教输入伴侣名字最简单的方法是：
先给您的伴侣发送一条私信，
然后左键点击聊天框左侧的名字区域。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Press the ''Ctrl'' and ''C''
keys to copy the name. Then,
you can paste the name into
the input prompt by pressing
the ''Insert'' and ''Shift'' keys. That sounds easy, right?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
按下''Ctrl''和''C''键复制名字。
然后，您可以按下''Insert''和''Shift''键，
将名字粘贴到输入框中。听起来很简单，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Alright, now let's try
it. Practice giving me the
name of your partner using
the method I just described.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
好了，现在我们来试试。
请按照我刚才描述的方法，
试着向我说出您伴侣的名字。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Alright, after you've
decided to get married,
come back to me and
submit your application.
I'll see you later, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
好的，当您决定结婚后，
请回来找我提交申请。
再见了，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
^FF0000Wait!^000000
^FF0000If your account in not a premium, you must have a Marriage Covenant to get married.^000000
^FF0000Please check the current state of your account, and the one of your lover, before register for a wedding.^000000
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
^FF0000等等！^000000
^FF0000如果您的账户不是高级账户，您必须持有结婚契约才能结婚。^000000
^FF0000请在登记婚礼前，检查您和您爱人的账户状态。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
So you'd like to get married?
As a groom, you need to prepare
^3377FF1 Tuxedo^000000 and give me your ^3377FF1 Marriage Covenant^000000.
Brides have to provide their own Wedding Dresses and pay a fee
of 1,200,000 zeny or also bring a Marriage Covenant.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
您想要结婚吗？
作为新郎，您需要准备
^3377FF1燕尾服^000000，并将您的^3377FF1结婚契约^000000交给我。
新娘需要提供自己的结婚礼服，并支付1,200,000 Zeny的费用，或者也携带一份结婚契约。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
So you'd like to get married?
As a groom, you need to prepare
^3377FF1 Tuxedo^000000 and pay ^3377FF1,300,000 zeny^000000.
Brides have to provide their own Wedding Dresses and pay a fee
of 1,200,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
您想要结婚吗？
作为新郎，您需要准备
^3377FF1燕尾服^000000，并支付^3377FF1,300,000 Zeny^000000。
新娘需要提供自己的结婚礼服，并支付1,200,000 Zeny的费用。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
So you'd like to get married?
As a bride, you need to prepare
^3377FF1 Wedding Dress^000000 and give me your ^3377FFMarriage Covenant^000000.
Grooms must bring a Tuxedo and pay
1,300,000 zeny or also bring a Marriage Covenant.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
您想要结婚吗？
作为新娘，您需要准备
^3377FF1结婚礼服^000000，并将您的^3377FF结婚契约^000000交给我。
新郎必须携带燕尾服，并支付1,300,000 Zeny，或者也携带一份结婚契约。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
So you'd like to get married?
As a bride, you need to prepare
^3377FF1 Wedding Dress^000000 and pay a fee of 1,200,000 zeny. Grooms must
bring a Tuxedo and pay 1,300,000 zeny to get married.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
您想要结婚吗？
作为新娘，您需要准备
^3377FF1结婚礼服^000000，并支付1,200,000 Zeny的费用。
新郎必须携带燕尾服，并支付1,300,000 Zeny才能结婚。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Brides and grooms also need
to have ^3377FF1 Diamond Ring^000000 to be
exchanged with their partners.
You'll need all of these items
prepared when you submit your
wedding ceremony application.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
新娘和新郎还需要
^3377FF1钻石戒指^000000，
以便在婚礼上与伴侣交换。
在提交婚礼申请时，
您需要准备好所有这些物品。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
The prospective bride and
groom must both complete
application process before
the wedding can take place.
Now, would you like to
apply for marriage?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
准新娘和准新郎都必须
完成申请流程，婚礼才能举行。
现在，您想要申请结婚吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
I'm sorry, but you can't
apply for another marriage!
I can't allow you to betray
your spouse like that, and
besides, polygamy isn't
legal here in Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
很抱歉，您不能申请另一场婚礼！
我不能允许您那样背叛您的配偶，
而且，在卢恩·米德加兹，重婚是不合法的。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Didn't you already
complete the application?
Hmm, make sure that your
partner also finished the
application process, and
then talk to Bishop Vomars.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
您不是已经完成了申请吗？
嗯，请确保您的伴侣也完成了申请流程，
然后去和主教沃马斯对话。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Hmm, you need to be
strong enough to protect
the one that you love before
you can consider marriage.
After you grow stronger,
come and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
嗯，在您考虑结婚之前，
您需要足够强大，以保护您爱的人。
等您变强之后，
再来和我谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Mm? Did you forget to
bring the Diamond Ring
to exchange with your partner
during the wedding ceremony?
Look for it carefully and come
back after you find it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
嗯？您是不是忘了带
用于在婚礼上与伴侣交换的
钻石戒指？
请仔细找找，找到后再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
I'm sorry, but all brides
must pay the 1,200,000
zeny fee or bring a Marriage
Covenant to proceed with the
wedding ceremony. Perhaps
you could ask your partner
to help you with the funds?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
很抱歉，所有新娘都必须支付1,200,000 Zeny的费用，或者出示结婚契约才能进行婚礼仪式。
也许您可以请您的伴侣帮您凑齐这笔钱？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Oh dear, did you forget
your Wedding Dress?
Hurry and find it, then
bring it to me-- you
absolutely need it
for the wedding!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
哎呀，您是不是忘了带结婚礼服？
快去把它找回来交给我——
婚礼上您绝对需要它！

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have the 1,300,000 zeny
or the Marriage Covenant
that all grooms must pay
for the wedding ceremony.
Did you misplace your money?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
很抱歉，您没有支付1,300,000 Zeny的费用，也没有出示所有新郎都必须提供的结婚契约。
您是不是把钱弄丢了？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Where's your Tuxedo?
You absolutely have to
wear it during the wedding
ceremony! Find it, bring it
to me, and then we can finally
begin the wedding, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
您的燕尾服在哪里？
婚礼仪式期间您必须穿上它！
把它找回来交给我，然后我们就能正式开始婚礼了，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Well, it looks like you
have everything ready.
Although I'm not sure who
your partner is, let me be
the first to congratulate you
on your upcoming wedding~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
看来您已经准备好了一切。
虽然我不确定您的伴侣是谁，但请允许我第一个祝贺您即将举行的婚礼~

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Now, let's begin the
application. Please write
down your exact name here.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
现在，让我们开始申请流程。请在这里写下您的准确姓名。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Hmmm, you have to write
down your name exactly as
it is displayed. Maybe you
need to copy and paste it?
Anyway, let's try it again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
嗯，您必须按照显示的样子准确写下您的姓名。也许您需要复制并粘贴它？
不管怎样，让我们再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Great, it looks like we
finished your application.
Remember that you'll need
to tell Bishop Vomars your
partner's exact name when
you talk to him later, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
很好，看来我们已经完成了您的申请。
请记住，稍后您去和主教沃马斯对话时，需要告诉他您伴侣的准确姓名，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
When your partner is
finished with the application
process, both of you should
speak to the Bishop to begin
the wedding ceremony.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
当您的伴侣完成申请流程后，你们两人都应该去和主教对话，以开始婚礼仪式。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Since you're the bride,
you need to wait for the
groom to speak to Bishop
Vomars first. When he's
finished, it'll be your turn
to speak to Bishop Vomars.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
既然您是新娘，您需要等待新郎先和主教沃马斯对话。等他完成后，就轮到您去和主教沃马斯对话了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Since you're the groom,
you need to speak to the
Bishop first. When you're
finished, it will be your
bride's turn to speak to
Bishop Vomars.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
既然您是新郎，您需要先和主教对话。当您完成后，就轮到您的新娘去和主教沃马斯对话了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
No...?
Well, when you're
ready for marriage,
feel free to come back to
me so that you can apply,
okay? Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
不...？
好吧，当您准备好结婚时，随时欢迎回来找我申请，好吗？祝您愉快~

scripts.text:

^CC9933You have to refine
items on your own to
make great equipment!^000000
scripts.translation:

^CC9933你必须自己强化物品，才能打造出色的装备！^000000

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Greetings, child.
Are you lost? Hmmm.
Do you know where your
mommy and daddy are?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
你好，孩子。
你迷路了吗？嗯。
你知道你的爸爸和妈妈在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Young lovers, please
remember this moment for
the rest of your lives. May your future be blessed with peace
and joy. May the love you share
grow with each passing day.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
年轻的恋人们，
请铭记这一刻，
直到生命的尽头。
愿你们的未来充满
和平与喜悦。
愿你们之间的爱
随着日子一天天加深。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Until the end of the
world, may you stand
by the side of the one
whom you love, to support
her and protect her. Now, may
I know the name of your bride?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
直到世界尽头，
愿你们始终陪伴在
爱人身边，
支持她，保护她。
现在，
请告诉我新娘的名字？

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Mr. {0}...
Do you swear on your life
that you will forever cherish
and care for your bride,
Miss {1}?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
{0}先生...
你愿意以生命发誓，
永远珍视并照顾
你的新娘，
{1}小姐吗？

scripts.text: I do.
scripts.translation: 我愿意。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Now, it is time for
your bride to make
her wedding vows.
If she will come forward...
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
现在，
是时候让新娘
宣读结婚誓词了。
如果她愿意上前...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I'm sorry, but the groom
must speak to me first in
order to begin the wedding.
It's old fashioned protocol,
but I'll admit that it does
keep things running smoothly.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
很抱歉，新郎必须
先与我对话，
才能开始婚礼。
这是老派的规矩，
但我承认，
这确实能让流程更顺畅。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Before you can be
married, you must
first form a party of
two with your partner.
Then, we can proceed
with the ceremony.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
在结婚之前，
你必须先与你的伴侣
组成一个两人的队伍。
然后，
我们才能继续举行仪式。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
You must apply for
marriage with Happy Marry
before you can get married.
Happy Marry will let you know
what else you'll need to do
to prepare for marriage.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
在结婚之前，
你必须先向快乐婚姻
申请结婚。
快乐婚姻会告诉你
还需要做什么
来为婚姻做准备。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Young lovers, please
remember this moment for
the rest of your lives. May your future be blessed with peace
and joy. May the love you share
grow with each passing day.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
年轻的恋人们，
请铭记这一刻，
直到生命的尽头。
愿你们的未来充满
和平与喜悦。
愿你们之间的爱
随着日子一天天加深。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Miss {0}...
Do you swear to stay
true to {1},
to be by his side, no matter
what the dangers may be?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
{0}小姐...
你愿意发誓忠于{1}，
无论面临何种危险，
都始终陪伴在他身边吗？

scripts.text: I do.
scripts.translation: 我愿意。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
So {0}
isn't the one you
want to marry? Hmm.
I'm truly sorry for this
misunderstanding...
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
所以{0}
不是你想结婚的人？嗯。
对于这种误会，
我深感抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Do you truly swear
fidelity and patience?
Will you marry {0}?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
你真的发誓
忠诚和耐心吗？
你愿意嫁给{0}吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
By the power invested
in me as Royal Bishop of
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom,
I now pronounce you husband
and wife. May your future be
blessed with many great joys.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
凭借卢恩·米德加兹王国
皇家主教赋予我的权力，
我宣布你们结为夫妻。
愿你们的未来
充满许多巨大的喜悦。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
And lastly...
Always be happy,
dear {0}...
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
最后...
亲爱的{0}，
永远幸福吧...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Hm. It seems that
your groom left before
the ceremony has finished
Please try again once he's
returned.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
嗯。看起来
你的新郎在仪式结束前
离开了。
请等他回来后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Hm. It seems that
you've changed your
mind. Although I feel
sorry for the groom, you
must do what your heart
tells you is right. Now, run!
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
嗯。看来
你改变主意了。虽然我为
新郎感到难过，但你
必须听从内心的声音。
现在，快跑吧！

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Hm? It appears that
Happy Marry still hasn't
received your marriage
application. Please speak
to her so that we can begin
the wedding ceremony.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
嗯？看起来
快乐婚姻还没有
收到你的结婚申请。
请与她对话，
以便我们开始婚礼仪式。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I wish you eternal
happiness. No matter
how dark the present may
be, always stand by your
loved one's side and look
to the future with hope.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
祝你们永远幸福。
无论现在多么黑暗，
请始终陪伴在爱人身边，
满怀希望地展望未来。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
The wedding of
Miss {0} and
Mister {1}
is currently in progress.
Please keep your voice down.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
{0}小姐和
{1}先生的婚礼
正在进行中。
请保持安静。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I'm conducting a wedding
for another couple now, so
please wait patiently for your
turn. Thanks for understanding...
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
我现在正在为另一对
新人主持婚礼，
请耐心等候轮到你们。
谢谢理解...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Wh-who are you?
You must know the
password to invoke
my awesome powers.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
你...你是谁？
你必须知道密码，
才能召唤我
强大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
This is
no place for
fooling around.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
这里不是
可以胡闹的地方。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Switch]
Is there a problem with
the wedding ceremony?
I can reset the Bishop
Vomars NPC if you like.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼开关]
婚礼仪式出问题了？
如果您愿意，我可以重置沃马斯主教NPC。

scripts.text: No, thanks
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text: RESET
scripts.translation: 重置

scripts.text:
[Wedding Switch]
Alright, then.
However, if the
Bishop Vomars
NPC is stuck, it may
be best to reset it.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼开关]
好的。
不过，如果沃马斯主教NPC卡住了，
最好还是重置一下。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Switch]
The Bishop Vomars NPC
has now been reactivated.
It should now be possible
to proceed with weddings.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼开关]
沃马斯主教NPC已重新激活。
现在应该可以继续进行婚礼了。

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
Uh oh...
You know I can't
do anything for you.
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
哎呀...
你知道我帮不了你。

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
Hmm...
You really
shouldn't be
in this place...
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
嗯...
你不应该
出现在这个地方...

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
Great, you know the
password! Now, did you
want me to remove the
Wedding Ring in your
inventory?
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
很好，你知道密码！
那么，你想让我移除
你背包里的结婚戒指吗？

scripts.text: Drop 1 Wedding Ring.
scripts.translation: 丢弃1枚结婚戒指

scripts.text: Keep it.
scripts.translation: 保留

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
It's done!
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
完成了！

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
I couldn't find
the Wedding Ring...
Please make sure
that it's not equipped.
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
我没找到结婚戒指...
请确认它没有装备在身上。

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
You sure you want
to keep that ring?
Alright, but if it becomes
a problem, you come to me.
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
你确定要保留那枚戒指吗？
好吧，但如果它成了问题，
你就来找我。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Hmm...?
What exactly are
you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
嗯...？
你在这里
到底想做什么？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Ahk!
An adventurer
like you shouldn't
be in this place!
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
啊！
像你这样的冒险者
不应该出现在这里！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Hmm...
I can only create
a Wedding Ring if the
character is married.
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
嗯...
只有当角色已婚时，
我才能制作结婚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Ah, I see that you
know the password.
Alright, if you somehow
lost your Wedding Ring,
I can make you a new one.
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
啊，看来你知道密码。
好吧，如果你不小心弄丢了结婚戒指，
我可以给你做一枚新的。

scripts.text: Make new Wedding Ring.
scripts.translation: 制作新的结婚戒指

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Wait, wait...
You're wearing your
Wedding Ring. I better
not make you another since
you don't need more than one.
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
等等，等等...
你正戴着结婚戒指。我最好
不给你做另一枚，因为你不需要
超过一枚。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Here you go~
It's your brand
new Wedding Ring!
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
给你~
这是你崭新的结婚戒指！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Alright. If you ever
lose your Wedding Ring,
come to me if you happen
to need a new one, okay?
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
好的。如果你以后弄丢了结婚戒指，
需要新的话就来找我，好吗？
